text:
olivia: Huge shoutout to @jamal and @dana — demo would have tanked without the quick proxy rollback and the late-night ramen run 🍜🙏
jamal: lol midnight ops + ramen = my cardio :runner: glad it worked, olivia. nice saves by @dana on the nginx config.
dana: team win. adjusted the timeout, rolled back the bad config, and called the ramen place. ordered more than we needed so help yourselves in the kitchen fridge (labels inside).
sophie: absolute legends. thanks for jumping in so fast — demo still looks glorious. :tada:
liam: putting a bagel fund in the 📎 for the oncall heroes. who wants in?
emma: count me in. @olivia if you want a coffee on me tomorrow for the panic demo :coffee:
ops-bot: Incident #2026 CLOSED by dana — root cause: config typo on nginx (missing keepalive). Automated rollback executed.
olivia: @jamal @dana you two saved the deck and my sleep. seriously appreciate it. going to add a tiny postmortem note in #eng-oncall tomorrow so we can avoid the same trap.
dana: no prob. quick note: I pushed a small lint check to catch missing keepalive next PR.
jamal: ramen pic: <image_2026.jpg> — it was actually really good. :yum:
sophie: pics or it didn't happen. saving that as team morale artifact. :camera_with_flash:
liam: +1 on documenting. also applause for late-night snack logistics. :clap::clap:
emma: dinner karma paid forward. whoever opens the snack drawer next week gets my cookie stash. :cookie:
olivia: officially filing two kudos: one for infra reflexes, one for ramen diplomacy. thank you all ❤️
jamal: night crew forever. catch you all tomorrow.
ops-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation for week 12 starts Monday — ping @oncall to swap if needed.
